overview.title: Head-to-Toe Care at Airrosti
overview.text: Our providers diagnose and treat most common muscle and joint conditions, including pain in the neck, back, shoulders, hips, elbows, knees and feet.

services.title: Ankle Pain
services.text: Ankle sprains and strains are among the most common injuries, often causing pain, swelling and difficulty walking. A sprain affects the ligaments that connect the bones of the ankle, while a strain affects the muscles or tendons.
services.lead: Strained and sprained ankles are often caused by sports, physical activities or simply stepping on uneven surfaces. We take the time needed for a thorough examination to find the underlying cause of your pain, then use hands-on manual therapy to treat your specific ankle injury, reduce pain, increase mobility and accelerate healing.

services.title: Foot Pain
services.summary: Heel, arch and ball of the foot pain
services.text: Feet are flexible structures of bones, joints, muscles and soft tissues that act as shock absorbers for the rest of the body, which leaves them susceptible to painful injuries. Common causes include plantar fasciitis, Achilles tendonitis, sprains and strains, stress fractures, Sever's disease and heel spurs.
services.lead: Foot pain could be caused by a recent acute injury, such as a fall, or it can be the result of a chronic condition that has slowly got worse, and most foot problems are sustained from mechanical issues such as overuse, improper footwear or arch issues such as flat feet. Pain tends to be localized in the ball of the foot, the arch, the top of the foot or the toe joints, though an injury to the foot can also cause pain in the ankle, knee, hip and low back.

services.title: Leg Pain
services.text: Leg pain often appears when overuse or trauma affects one of the lower body's muscles, ligaments, tendons or other soft tissues. Common causes include Achilles tendonitis, calf strain, hamstring strain, IT band syndrome, patellar tendonitis and quad strain.
services.lead: These injuries occur frequently during activities involving heavy, repeated leg use, like running, jumping or kicking, or due to sudden impact or changes in direction or speed, and muscles weakened from lack of use can be a risk factor too. Leg pain can also be referred, meaning the source of the pain comes from another part of the body, such as the lower back or hips.

services.title: Knee Pain
services.summary: Runner's knee, IT band and kneecap pain
services.text: The knee joint is the largest joint in the body and is comprised of various tissues, ligaments and tendons, which makes it highly susceptible to injuries from repetitive stress. Knee pain can often be a symptom of issues with the hip or ankle.
services.lead: Knee pain can result from direct injury, overuse, muscle tightness or other underlying conditions, and tightness in the adductors, hip flexors, quadriceps and hamstrings can alter how the knee absorbs impact during movement. A few common knee injuries include patellar tendonitis, knee bursitis, knee sprains and strains, MCL or LCL sprains and strains, Osgood-Schlatter disease, knee osteoarthritis and IT band syndrome.

services.title: Hip Pain
services.text: The hip is one of the largest joints in the body, and the ligaments, muscles and fascia surrounding the joint must work in unison for it to move through its full range. Common hip problems caused by strain and overuse include hip tendonitis, hip bursitis and hip flexor strain.
services.lead: Untreated acute trauma is often the cause of hip pain, but any source of inflammation may cause discomfort in the hip area, along with swelling, warmth and redness. Depending on the condition, you may feel it in the upper thigh, inside or outside the hip joint, around the groin, around the buttocks or in the low back, and the pain may be worse at night or when getting up from a seated position.

services.title: Back Pain
services.summary: Upper and middle back pain and strains
services.text: Upper back pain can have several causes, including muscle strains from repetitive movements or overexertion, direct impacts from accidents or falls, herniated discs, degenerative conditions, poor posture and spinal stenosis. Middle back pain shares many of the same symptoms.
services.lead: Symptoms of back pain depend on the type of injury or condition, and commonly include aching or throbbing pain, sharp or stabbing sensations, muscle tightness and tension, and tingling or numbness that extends from the upper back to the shoulders and arms. Other treatments focus on managing symptoms, but Airrosti focuses on eliminating the underlying problem.

services.title: Low Back Pain
services.summary: Lumbar strains, disc and chronic pain
services.text: The lumbar spine is intricately designed to support the upper body and enable everyday movements, and that complexity makes it prone to injury. Lower back pain commonly arises from a torn or pulled muscle or ligament, occurring suddenly or developing gradually from repetitive movements.
services.lead: Common causes of lower back sprains and strains include lifting a heavy object or twisting the spine while lifting, sudden movements or direct impacts such as a fall, a lack of proper posture, and sports-related injuries. Pain is considered chronic once it lasts for more than three months, which is often the result of a disc problem, a joint problem, an unresolved injury from past trauma or irritated spinal nerve roots.

services.title: Sciatica
services.summary: Nerve pain that radiates down the leg
services.text: Sciatica is a symptom of an underlying medical condition rather than a diagnosis in itself, and the term describes nerve pain that radiates down the leg. It is usually caused by a compressed or pinched nerve in the lower spine.
services.lead: The sciatic nerve is the largest and longest nerve in the body, running from the lower back, through the buttock and splitting to run down the back of the legs, so any condition that inflames or irritates it can cause pain in the area. Common conditions resulting in sciatic pain include a herniated disc, lumbar spinal stenosis, piriformis syndrome or an injury to the lower back that puts pressure on the sciatic nerve.

process.title: What to Expect
process.text: Our average treatment plan is 3 visits, and patients stay active while they are in treatment.

steps.title: Scheduling and benefits
steps.text: Scheduling runs through our centralized scheduling center in San Antonio. We take your insurance information, verify your benefits and call you before your appointment to review estimated costs.

steps.title: Assessment and diagnosis
steps.text: Your provider sets aside time for range of motion, orthopedic and functional tests to identify the specific cause of your pain, without MRIs or X-rays in most cases.

steps.title: Targeted manual therapy
steps.text: Hands-on manual therapy, including joint mobilization, soft tissue manipulation and muscle energy techniques, is delivered to the injured soft tissue.

steps.title: Active recovery
steps.text: Active rehab follows the manual therapy at every visit, with a customized program of stretches and exercises to keep doing at home between visits.

about.title: About Airrosti Deer Park
text: Welcome to Airrosti Deer Park, where our dedicated team is committed to treating patients’ pain and injuries in Deer Park, TX. We provide exceptional patient experience, help you avoid costly or invasive procedures, and fix your pain fast!

Our skilled Providers are experienced in treating a wide range of conditions, including shoulder, knee, neck, back, and hip pain. Whether you’re an athlete seeking to resolve an acute injury or an individual dealing with chronic pain, we are here to help.

With a proven track record of success, our hands-on musculoskeletal treatment approach accurately diagnoses and rapidly resolves the source of most pain and injuries. We believe in addressing the root cause rather than just managing symptoms, allowing you to achieve long-lasting pain relief and regain your mobility and strength.

faqs.a: Insurance coverage varies by location and your individual policy structure. When you schedule your initial appointment, we will obtain your insurance information, verify benefits, and contact you before your appointment to review estimated costs. Airrosti is contracted with most major carriers.

faqs.q: What if I do not have insurance or my plan does not cover Airrosti care?
faqs.a: We offer a self-pay option, and self-pay rates vary by location. We accept all major credit cards, and HSA and Flex cards carrying a credit card logo, but we cannot accept cash at any location. Interest-free payment plans are available over up to 12 months.

faqs.q: How is Airrosti different from other care options?
faqs.a: Airrosti is a health care group that employs and trains providers who specialize in delivering high quality, outcome-based musculoskeletal care. Our focus on one-on-one patient time and a strict adherence to clinical best practices helps significantly reduce recovery times, while preventing many unnecessary costs associated with imaging, pharmaceuticals, and even surgical procedures.

faqs.q: How do I know if Airrosti can help with my condition?
faqs.a: We treat a wide range of chronic and acute conditions. During your first visit, our provider will thoroughly assess and diagnose your condition and determine if Airrosti can effectively resolve it. If your provider determines you are not a good candidate for treatment, or you choose not to move forward with care, he or she will refer you to a specialist as appropriate.

faqs.q: What is active recovery and why is it important?
faqs.a: Active recovery is done during each visit, immediately following the highly targeted manual therapy designed to restore function to your body and correct injuries to the soft tissue. It is a customized program of stretches and exercises that target the specific area of your injury, and doing them consistently at home helps speed recovery and prevent future injuries.

Our providers are well trained to deliver a very safe and effective treatment. Any discomfort you feel should be extremely temporary and will lead to a significant reduction in your current pain level. You will also receive detailed instructions for minimizing any post-treatment discomfort.

Due to our carrier arrangements, Airrosti only accepts and bills primary insurance. Patients can reach their superbills through the Airrosti Patient Portal to file claims with a secondary carrier themselves.
Airrosti DC providers are enrolled, but not participating, in Medicare. Our DC providers can see Medicare patients at our self-pay rates, and the Medicare ABN form must be completed at every visit.

facts.heading: Patient Outcomes
facts.text: 88% of patients reported complete injury resolution after finishing their treatment plan and 94% reported improvement. 93% said Airrosti eliminated or significantly reduced their need for pain medication, and 91% said it prevented the need for further medical services.

facts.heading: Insurance and Payment
facts.text: Airrosti is contracted with most major carriers and only bills primary insurance. We may not be able to verify benefits in advance for appointments booked with less than 48 hours' notice, and self-pay, HSA and Flex card payment and interest-free payment plans are available.

facts.heading: Beyond Chiropractic Care and Physical Therapy
facts.text: We combine hands-on manual therapy with active rehab exercises rather than routine chiropractic adjustments alone, and we focus on finding and fixing the root cause without surgery or prescription painkillers.

facts.heading: Virtual Care
